infer_bases: infer_bases infer the possible output values and vector bases of SOps in a computation graph
create_InferBasesOutput: create an InferBasesOutput dataclass containing a directed graph of inferred bases
compute_value_set_Map: compute value set for a Map S-Op by applying its function to each inner value
compute_value_set_Aggregate: compute value set for an Aggregate S-Op by averaging binary variables over sequence lengths
compute_value_set_SequenceMap: compute value set for a SequenceMap S-Op by applying its function to all pairs of operand values
